# Trulia

> > Trulia is a comprehensive real estate marketplace providing home listings, rental properties, and housing data across the United States.

Trulia connects home buyers, renters, and sellers with detailed property listings, neighborhood information, and market data. The platform covers residential real estate across all 50 states, major metropolitan areas like San Francisco, Chicago, and San Diego, as well as smaller markets and communities nationwide.

## Key Topics

- Real estate listings
- Homes for sale
- Rental properties and apartments
- Property search and marketplace
- Housing market data
- Neighborhood reviews
- MLS listings
- State and local real estate markets
- Residential property types
- Townhomes and condos
- Property rental search
- Home buying and selling
- Real estate pricing and valuations

## Core Services

- [Trulia: Real Estate Listings, Homes For Sale, Housing Data](https://www.trulia.com/): Homepage for Trulia real estate marketplace with home listings & rentals
- [Apartments for Rent, Houses & Local Rentals](https://www.trulia.com/rent/): Rental search hub for apartments, houses, townhomes & condos

## State Real Estate Markets

- [Arkansas Real Estate & AR Homes For Sale](https://www.trulia.com/AR/): Arkansas state listings page with 27,077 homes for sale
- [Michigan Real Estate & MI Homes For Sale](https://www.trulia.com/MI/): Michigan state listings page featuring 34,922 homes for sale
- [New Hampshire Real Estate & NH Homes For Sale](https://www.trulia.com/NH/): New Hampshire state listings with 3,187 homes for sale
- [District Of Columbia Real Estate & DC Homes For Sale](https://www.trulia.com/DC/): Washington DC area listings with 2,740 homes for sale
